title: Sudden Death visual cues — banner + screen-edge red vignette pulse
notes: Ships the §VISUAL TREATMENT polish from GDP-2026-05-27-013 that was deferred when S160 shipped sudden-death core logic. On the tick we observe SuddenDeathState.activated flipping false→true, mount a centre HUD banner ('SUDDEN DEATH', cream font, red-bordered card, 1.5 s fade-in/hold/fade-out cycle) plus a screen-edge red box-shadow vignette pulse (~1 s).
On round restart (SuddenDeathState component goes missing) both elements reset so the next round can re-trigger them.
Live probe (?suddenDeathTriggerS=2) confirmed: banner + vignette in DOM at activation moment; multi-variant red sudden-death walls visible alongside the vignette + the S165 hard/soft-block variants.

stories.title: Centre HUD banner — 'SUDDEN DEATH' fade-in/hold/fade-out
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — drives a kaboom.sudden-death-banner widget. 32 px cream font, letter-spacing 6 px, red text-shadow + red 2 px border. Fade-in 250 ms → hold 1000 ms → fade-out 250 ms.
verification: acceptance: banner with text 'SUDDEN DEATH' present in DOM at activation moment; removed after 1.5 s; re-mounted on next round's activation.

stories.title: Screen-edge red box-shadow vignette pulse
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — appends a kaboom-sudden-death-vignette div to document.body on first activation; per-frame opacity + box-shadow extent driven by elapsed-since-activation (peak at 0.4-0.6 s, fades by 1 s). Cleaned up on hudCleanup.
verification: acceptance: #kaboom-sudden-death-vignette in DOM after activation; opacity > 0 during the 1 s pulse window; reset to 0 when the round ends.
